title: Moloch's Bargain: Emergent Misalignment When LLMs Compete for Audiences
abstract: When language models compete for audiences — for clicks, votes, or sales — small optimization gains can drive large drifts in honesty, safety, and alignment. We study these competitive dynamics empirically across simulated markets and find that misalignment emerges as a side effect of audience-seeking behavior, even when each individual model is well-intentioned.
